Class IteratorAdapter

java.lang.Object
myAdapter.IteratorAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
HIterator
Direct Known Subclasses:
ListIteratorAdapter
public class IteratorAdapter extends Object implements HIterator
An adapter that implements the HIterator interface to iterate over elements of a VectorAdapter or a specific portion of it, with support for element removal.

  • Field Details

    • cursor

      protected int cursor
      The current position of this iterator cursor. The next element to be returned by next() is at this index. This iterator only moves forward.

    • lastRet

      protected int lastRet
      The index of the last element returned by next() or -1 if no element has been returned yet or if the element has been removed.

    • start

      protected int start
      The starting index (inclusive) of the iteration range within the vector. This represents the offset of the underlying VectorAdapter.

    • end

      protected int end
      The ending index (exclusive) of the iteration range within the vector.

    • vect

      protected VectorAdapter vect
      The VectorAdapter being iterated. This adapter provides access to the underlying elements that this iterator traverses.

      public boolean hasNext()
      Returns true if the iteration has more elements. (In other words, returns true if next would return an element rather than throwing an exception.)

    • remove

      public void remove()
      Removes from the underlying collection the last element returned by the iterator (optional operation). This method can be called only once per call to next. The behavior of an iterator is unspecified if the underlying collection is modified while the iteration is in progress in any way other than by calling this method.
      Specified by:
      remove in interface HIterator
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the next method has not yet been called, or the remove method has already been called after the last call to the next method.
